subject: Quantitative Aptitude
question: The average of 5 numbers is 20. If one number is removed, the average of the remaining 4 numbers becomes 18. What is the removed number?
solution: Sum of 5 numbers = 5 * 20 = 100. Sum of 4 numbers = 4 * 18 = 72. Removed number = 100 - 72 = 28. Topic (Average) is in the SSC CGL syllabus. Source: https://ssc.gov.in/api/assets/uploads/master-data/Syllabus/Syllabus_CGL_2024.pdf
author: Hermes
